description: This file defines atomic types and functions for thread-safe operations, including atomic integers, floats, booleans, and pointer classes, with inline functions wrapping platform-specific atomic primitives.

classes.name: atomic_base
classes.description: Template class providing thread-safe atomic operations with mutex locking for any trivially copyable type.

classes.name: atomic_number
classes.description: Subclass of atomic_base adding fetch_add and fetch_sub methods for numeric types.

classes.name: atomic_integral
classes.description: Subclass of atomic_number adding increment and decrement methods for integer types.

classes.name: atomic_pointer
classes.description: Template class for atomic pointer types.

classes.name: atomic_bool
classes.description: Atomic boolean type with lock-free operations.

methods.name: Release_CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap with release semantics for SbAtomic8.

methods.name: NoBarrier_Store
methods.description: Performs a store operation without memory barriers for SbAtomic8 and SbAtomic32.

methods.name: NoBarrier_Load
methods.description: Performs a load operation without memory barriers for SbAtomic8 and SbAtomic32.

methods.name: NoBarrier_CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap without barriers for SbAtomic32 and SbAtomic64.

methods.name: NoBarrier_Exchange
methods.description: Performs an atomic exchange without barriers for SbAtomic32 and SbAtomic64.

methods.name: NoBarrier_Increment
methods.description: Performs an atomic increment without barriers for SbAtomic32 and SbAtomic64.

methods.name: Barrier_Increment
methods.description: Performs an atomic increment with barrier for SbAtomic32 and SbAtomic64.

methods.name: Acquire_CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap with acquire semantics for SbAtomic32 and SbAtomic64.

methods.name: Release_CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap with release semantics for SbAtomic32 and SbAtomic64.

methods.name: Acquire_Store
methods.description: Performs an atomic store with acquire semantics for SbAtomic32 and SbAtomic64.

methods.name: Release_Store
methods.description: Performs an atomic store with release semantics for SbAtomic32 and SbAtomic64.

methods.name: Acquire_Load
methods.description: Performs an atomic load with acquire semantics for SbAtomic32 and SbAtomic64.

methods.name: Release_Load
methods.description: Performs an atomic load with release semantics for SbAtomic32 and SbAtomic64.

methods.name: fetch_add
methods.description: Adds a value atomically and returns the previous value for atomic_int32_t, atomic_int64_t, and atomic_float.

methods.name: fetch_sub
methods.description: Subtracts a value atomically and returns the previous value for atomic_int32_t, atomic_int64_t, and atomic_float.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Atomically increments the integer value.

methods.name: decrement
methods.description: Atomically decrements the integer value.

methods.name: exchange
methods.description: Atomically replaces the value and returns the old value.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Atomically loads the current value.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Atomically stores a new value.

methods.name: compare_exchange_strong
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap, updating expected value on failure.

methods.name: compare_exchange_weak
methods.description: Weak version of compare-and-swap, may fail spuriously.
